title: Generative AI Developer
description: Build production AI applications utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and multi-agent workflows.

goal.objective: Architect enterprise applications that harness LLMs, multi-agent frameworks, semantic vector databases, and real-time knowledge retrieval.

learn.summary: Master LLM API orchestration, prompt chaining, LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vector indexing (Chroma, Pinecone, Qdrant), evaluation with Ragas, and semantic caching.
prerequisites: REST API consumption and backend design
Basic understanding of machine learning concepts

capstone_projects.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Market Intelligence System
capstone_projects.description: Build a team of AI agents that research, summarize, critique, and synthesize corporate earnings reports into PDF briefs.

capstone_projects.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Assistant with LangGraph
capstone_projects.description: Build a multi-agent system where independent specialist agents search the web, critique findings, execute Python code in sandboxes, and synthesize verified reports.

certifications: DeepLearning.AI Generative AI for Everyone & LLM Specialization
interview_focus: Vector Similarity Metrics (Cosine, Dot Product, Euclidean)
Agent Tool Calling & Loop Termination Guarantees
Latency, Token Cost & Semantic Caching Strategies

tree.name: Foundations of Generative AI & Application Development
tree.description: Establish a strong understanding of Generative AI principles, the landscape of Large Language Models (LLMs), core concepts like tokens, context windows, latency, and cost implications. This module also covers fundamental prompt design and an introduction to user experience considerations for AI-powered applications.

resources.title: What is Generative AI? - Full Course for Beginners
Large Language Models (LLMs) Explained - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: LLM API Integration and Management
children.description: Master the integration of LLMs via APIs from various providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini). Learn to handle chat/completion requests, manage API keys securely, implement streaming for real-time responses, manage rate limits, handle errors with robust retry mechanisms, estimate token usage for cost control, and parse structured model outputs (JSON, YAML).

resources.title: Build a Chatbot with OpenAI API & Python - Full Course
OpenAI API Python Tutorial - GPT-4, GPT-3.5, DALL-E 2, Whisper, Embeddings (2023)

children.name: Core Prompt Engineering Techniques
children.description: Develop proficiency in fundamental prompt engineering techniques including zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting. Learn to craft effective system messages, use persona-based prompting, design prompts for specific output formats (JSON, Markdown), and iterate on prompts for improved model performance and reliability.

resources.title: Prompt Engineering Full Course - LLM Guide for Beginners
A Beginner's Guide to Prompt Engineering (ChatGPT & Generative AI)

children.name: User Experience (UX) Design for AI Applications
children.description: Design intuitive and effective user interfaces for AI applications. Focus on user feedback mechanisms, handling AI uncertainties (loading states, confidence scores), displaying citations, enabling human review workflows, prompt controls, edit/refinement flows, and graceful recovery from AI failures. Understand ethical considerations and user trust in AI design.

resources.title: Designing AI: Principles for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence
UX for AI: Designing Intelligent Experiences

children.name: LLM Application Development Frameworks
children.description: Get started with popular LLM orchestration frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex. Understand their core components (chains, agents, tools, retrievers, parsers, memory), how they simplify complex LLM workflows, and set up your development environment. This module bridges foundational LLM interactions with advanced application patterns.

resources.title: LlamaIndex Crash Course - Build Your Own Custom ChatGPT with LlamaIndex and OpenAI

tree.name: Advanced Interaction: RAG, Tooling, and Autonomous Agents
tree.description: Build sophisticated AI applications by enabling models to interact with external data and tools. This section covers Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for grounding responses in private data, function/tool calling for external API interaction, and the development of intelligent, autonomous agents capable of multi-step reasoning.

resources.title: Build AI Agents with Function Calling, Tools and more!

children.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) Systems
children.description: Implement robust RAG systems to connect LLMs to external knowledge sources. Learn document loading, various text chunking strategies (fixed size, recursive, semantic), different embedding models, vector database selection (e.g., Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate), advanced retrieval techniques (hybrid search, semantic search), re-ranking algorithms, and integrating citations for source attribution. Focus on debugging retrieval quality and minimizing hallucinations.

children.name: Advanced RAG Optimizations and Architectures
children.description: Dive into sophisticated RAG techniques to enhance performance and accuracy. Cover topics like query rewriting, hypothetical document embedding (HyDE), context compression, self-correction mechanisms in RAG, multi-query approaches, RAG-Fusion, and exploring multi-modal RAG systems. Understand the tradeoffs and applications of different RAG architectures.

resources.title: Advanced RAG Techniques: A Deep Dive (Towards Data Science)
Advanced RAG Techniques | Best RAG Frameworks | RAG with LlamaIndex

children.name: Function Calling, External Tools, and Agentic Workflows
children.description: Enable LLMs to perform actions by calling external APIs and tools. Learn to define tools, implement function calling with precise argument validation, manage multi-step tool use, handle state across interactions, recover gracefully from tool execution errors, and design workflows that keep humans in the loop for critical decisions. Explore the foundations of agentic behavior.

resources.title: Building Tools and Function Calling with LLMs (Google Developers)

children.name: Building and Deploying Autonomous Agents
children.description: Explore advanced agent architectures and design patterns for building truly autonomous LLM applications. Learn about concepts like ReAct (Reasoning and Acting), planning, memory management, self-reflection, and implementing agents using frameworks like LangChain Agents or LlamaIndex Agents. Understand how to manage complex multi-agent systems and their application in real-world scenarios.

resources.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in LLMs (Paper)
Build Autonomous Agents with LangChain, Next.js, and Pinecone

children.name: Practice Lab: RAG Retrieval and Grounding Debugging
children.description: Hands-on practice in debugging RAG systems. Test various chunking strategies, identify retrieval misses, analyze the impact of different embedding models, verify citation accuracy, and troubleshoot hallucinations. Implement techniques to improve answer grounding and overall RAG system reliability through iterative testing.

resources.title: RAG System Architecture & Best Practices - Learn to Build a RAG from Scratch
Evaluating and Debugging RAG Applications with Ragas

tree.name: Robustness: Evaluation, Safety, Ethics, and Cost Optimization
tree.description: Ensure the reliability, safety, ethical compliance, and cost-efficiency of Generative AI applications. This module covers systematic evaluation methodologies, implementing robust safety and privacy measures, understanding responsible AI principles, and optimizing deployment costs for sustainable operation.

resources.title: Responsible AI Explained: What is Responsible AI?
How to Evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) & Benchmarking LLMs for Production

children.name: Evaluation Metrics and Continuous Testing
children.description: Develop comprehensive evaluation strategies for LLM applications. Create golden datasets, design automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation pipelines, assess output quality using metrics like faithfulness, relevancy, answer correctness, fluency, and toxicity. Implement regression testing, track model changes, compare prompt versions, and integrate A/B testing for continuous improvement.

resources.title: Evaluating LLMs: A Comprehensive Guide (Weights & Biases)
How to Evaluate RAG with LangChain & Ragas

children.name: AI Observability and Performance Monitoring
children.description: Implement robust logging, tracing, and monitoring for Generative AI applications in production. Track key metrics such as prompts, model outputs, token usage, latency, cost, tool errors, retrieval misses, hallucination rates, and user feedback. Establish alerts and dashboards to ensure continuous optimal performance, detect model drift, and identify safety incidents.

resources.title: Observability for LLM Applications with OpenTelemetry & LangChain
LLM Observability and Monitoring - A Comprehensive Guide

children.name: Responsible AI: Safety, Ethics, and Cost Control
children.description: Address critical aspects of responsible AI development including safety, ethical considerations, and cost management. Learn to mitigate risks like prompt injection, adversarial attacks, PII leakage, model refusals, and abuse. Implement content moderation, output filtering, and strategies for managing token budgets, caching, rate limiting, and auditing logs for compliance and transparency.

resources.title: What is Responsible AI? (AI Explainability, Bias, Privacy & Security)
What is AI Ethics? Bias, Fairness, Privacy, and Explainable AI

children.name: Data Privacy and Security in LLM Applications
children.description: Implement best practices for securing data in LLM workflows. This includes data anonymization, encryption at rest and in transit, access control mechanisms, secure storage for sensitive data (e.g., vector databases), compliance with regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA), and strategies for handling proprietary or confidential information within RAG systems.

resources.title: Building Secure GenAI Applications with Amazon Bedrock (AWS)
Secure and Compliant Generative AI Applications
Securing your Generative AI models from data breaches

tree.name: Production Deployment and Scaling of AI Applications
tree.description: Prepare Generative AI applications for production. This module covers deploying scalable infrastructure, implementing CI/CD pipelines, managing model versions, ensuring security for secrets, collecting user feedback, and documenting the entire application lifecycle for maintainability and collaboration.

resources.title: FastAPI Tutorial: Deploying a Web Application

children.name: Cloud Deployment, Containerization, and MLOps
children.description: Master the deployment of GenAI applications to cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Learn containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, and serverless deployment options. Implement MLOps principles for automated build, test, and deployment pipelines, model versioning, artifact management, and infrastructure as code.

children.name: Capstone Project: Production-Ready Knowledge Assistant
children.description: Apply all learned concepts to build a comprehensive, production-grade RAG-based knowledge assistant. This project will involve document ingestion, advanced retrieval with citations, tool calling capabilities, an integrated evaluation dataset, robust safety checks, a user-facing dashboard for usage analytics and feedback, and detailed deployment notes for scaling and maintenance.

resources.title: Building a Full-Stack LLM App (Next.js, LangChain)
